stories.title: Propaganda or PSA? Trump's Taxpayer-Funded TV Ads Spark DNC Lawsuit
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Shuts Down Fake Outrage, Says He'll Pay for Ads Himself as Democrats Sue Over Public Service Messages
stories.liberal_headline: DNC Sues Trump Administration for Using Taxpayer Dollars on Campaign-Style Ads Weeks Before Midterms
stories.poll_question: Were Trump's government-funded TV ads illegal propaganda?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Routine government messaging; Democrats manufactured outrage for midterm headlines.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Public money funded campaign ads, violating federal anti-propaganda spending laws.

stories.title: Relief Checks or Election Bribe? Trump's $5,000 Payments and Medicare Rebates
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Delivers: $5,000 Checks and Medicare Rebates Headed to Americans as Economy Roars Back
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Dangles Cash Payments to Seniors and Voters Weeks Before an Election He's Losing
stories.poll_question: Are Trump's direct payments good policy or vote-buying?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Returning tariff revenue to families squeezed by years of inflation.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Timed cash giveaways distract from weak hiring and rising prices.

stories.title: Record Enforcement or Record Cruelty? ICE Arrests Hit All-Time High
stories.conservative_headline: ICE Smashes Arrest Records, Removes Murderers and Child Abusers as Crime Falls to Historic Lows
stories.liberal_headline: ICE Arrests Hit Record High as Agents Grab Parents at Colleges and Courthouses
stories.poll_question: Is record-high ICE enforcement making America safer?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Removing criminal aliens protects communities and finally enforces existing immigration law.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Indiscriminate arrests sweep up workers, students and families without due process.

stories.title: Peace Through Strength or Endless War? Trump Weighs New Strikes on Iran
stories.conservative_headline: Rubio: Iran Has Lost Control of Hormuz as Trump Keeps All Options on the Table
stories.liberal_headline: Seven Months In, Trump's Iran War Grinds On With No Exit — and Officials Plan More Strikes
stories.poll_question: Should the U.S. resume major combat operations against Iran?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Only military pressure stops Iranian nukes and reopens global shipping lanes.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Bombing failed for seven months; diplomacy is the only real off-ramp.

stories.title: Judicial Restraint or Climate Giveaway? Supreme Court Weighs Big Oil Liability Suits
stories.conservative_headline: Justices Signal Skepticism of Blue-State Lawfare Trying to Bankrupt American Energy Producers
stories.liberal_headline: Supreme Court Could Shield Oil Giants From Accountability as Alito Steps Aside Over Stock Holdings
stories.poll_question: Should states be allowed to sue oil companies over climate change?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Energy policy belongs in Congress, not activist state courtrooms and juries.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Companies that misled the public should face the same liability as anyone.

stories.title: Rooting Out Radicals or Weaponizing the FBI? Whistleblower Alleges Trump Ordered Protester Probe
stories.conservative_headline: Disgruntled Ex-Agent's Claims Recycled by Media as Patel Refocuses FBI on Crime and Illegal Immigration
stories.liberal_headline: Whistleblower: Trump Demanded FBI Investigate Protesters Over a TikTok Video He Watched
stories.poll_question: Did the White House abuse the FBI by targeting protesters?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Presidents may flag threats; agents investigate violence, not opinions or speech.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Ordering probes of critics over a video is textbook authoritarian retaliation.

stories.title: Accountability or Censorship? White House Boots Politico and CNN From Press Pool
stories.conservative_headline: White House Ends Special Treatment for Outlets That Traded Journalism for Activism
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Expands Press Purge, Removing Politico From Pool as Outlets Battle Ban in Court
stories.poll_question: Can the White House bar news outlets it dislikes?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Access is a privilege; biased outlets have no constitutional right to it.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Punishing critical coverage is viewpoint discrimination that chills a free press.

stories.title: Local Control or Gutting Standards? Trump Admin Moves to Roll Back Education Rules
stories.conservative_headline: Education Department Returns Power to Parents and States, Scrapping Washington's Failed Mandates
stories.liberal_headline: Democrats Blast 'Brazen' Trump Plan to Dismantle Federal Education Standards for America's Schools
stories.poll_question: Should Washington stop setting K-12 education standards?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Federal mandates failed students; parents and local boards know best.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Gutting standards abandons poor and disabled kids to unequal schooling.

stories.title: Fair Maps or Gutted Voting Rights? SCOTUS Tosses Latino Vote Dilution Finding
stories.conservative_headline: Supreme Court Reaffirms Race-Neutral Maps, Rejecting Racial Gerrymandering by Left-Wing Groups
stories.liberal_headline: Supreme Court Erases Finding That Washington Map Diluted Latino Votes, Deepening VRA Rollback
stories.poll_question: Should plaintiffs have to prove intentional racial discrimination in maps?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Districts shouldn't be drawn by race; intent standard restores equal treatment.
stories.poll_option2_desc: An impossible burden of proof effectively ends minority voting protections.

stories.title: Cheaper Drugs or Hollow Hype? Trump's Drug Pricing Claims Get a Reality Check
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Delivers Lowest Drug Prices in the World After Decades of Washington Failure
stories.liberal_headline: Report Finds TrumpRx Discounts a 'Mixed Bag' as President Oversells Drug Price Wins
stories.poll_question: Has Trump actually lowered Americans' prescription drug costs?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Deals with manufacturers cut prices no previous administration could touch.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Savings are narrow and inconsistent; most patients see little change.
